note: Invariants the skills must never violate. Split into a reusable core pack and a DG-specific pack so the harness can be extracted to other skills without rewriting. Detectors: regex_forbid (pattern must not appear on a line unless an exemption word is on the same line), regex_require (pattern must appear somewhere), structural (handled by check_structure.py), llm (fixed binary classifier, not auto-run — reported as unchecked so it is never silently skipped). Two invariants were removed after a pruning pass: CORE-BUR-01 (every artefact has a named reader) and CORE-BUR-02 (retires as much as it creates). Both duplicate dimension 8 of the CDO judge in skills/dg-strategy/SKILL.md, which runs on every deliverable anyway. Checking the same thing twice does not make it truer.

core.statement: A number carrying a low-reliability tag in the numbers registry is never quoted as fact
core.note: The exemption must be a discounting word, not a mention of the source. A negative test showed that exempting on the word 'vendor' lets the vendor's own number through when it is being used as a basis rather than discounted.

core.statement: A numeric target is never stated where the baseline is unmeasured; the gap marker stands in its place
core.prompt: Does this document state a numeric target for any metric whose current value it also says is unknown or unmeasured? Answer yes or no.

core.statement: Where the knowledge base has no material, the answer says so rather than improvising
core.prompt: The knowledge base has no material on: MDM and identity resolution, privacy and PII, retention and legal lifecycle, governing a legacy estate, external data suppliers. Does this text make substantive claims about any of those without declaring the gap? Answer yes or no.

core.statement: The gap marker is a visible bracketed flag, localised but never a footnote or a vague phrase
Every deliverable exists in both HTML and Markdown

dg.statement: Operational efficiency, innovation and accelerated decision-making never appear as effect lines
dg.note: Naming them in order to refuse them is required behaviour, hence the exemptions.

dg.statement: An expert-estimate figure never appears in the Summary as a headline number
Data quality never appears as its own ROI category; it resolves into revenue or cost
dg.prompt: Does this document present data quality as an independent source of economic effect, rather than resolving it into revenue or cost? Answer yes or no.

dg.statement: Reports are never certified before marts
dg.prompt: Does this document sequence report or dashboard certification before mart certification? Answer yes or no.

dg.statement: A catalog purchase is never recommended before ownership works in at least three domains
dg.prompt: Does this document recommend buying or deploying a data catalog without first establishing working ownership? Answer yes or no.

dg.statement: Self-service and agentic interfaces are never sequenced before trusted data
dg.prompt: Does this document place self-service or an AI assistant earlier in the sequence than certified core data and definitions? Answer yes or no.

dg.statement: No role is proposed without stated time and where that time is recorded
dg.prompt: For every role this document proposes, does it state how much time and in whose objectives that time is recorded? Answer with the count of roles failing that test.

dg.statement: A steward-only model is never recommended without stating the custodian alternative
At least one headline metric can legitimately fall; pure counters are labelled proxies out loud
dg.prompt: Can any headline metric in this document legitimately go down for a good reason? If not, are the counters explicitly labelled as proxies? Answer yes or no.

dg.statement: Counts of glossary terms, stewards, policies or meetings never appear as success metrics
The programme does not go to the business under the literal flag of data governance
dg.prompt: Does this document propose presenting the work to business stakeholders under the name 'data governance' rather than under an existing funded mandate or a named pain? Answer yes or no.

deliverable.note: Default. A strategy, audit report or answer produced by a skill.

skill.note: The skill definition itself is the source of the rules, so it necessarily quotes what it forbids. Only structural checks apply. Content is governed by the contradiction review, not by this harness.

kb.note: Knowledge-base theme files record positions and counter-positions verbatim from source material; forbid detectors are meaningless on them.
